description: Binary assertions for learn-practice — drills, interleaving schedule, 90-min focus session. Static audit of SKILL.md. Rule-level correctness of the schedule template (no adjacent single-topic sessions, ODI not DMIR) is checked by scripts/test_learn_skill_consistency.py, which regex cannot express.
test_input: study plan: Pahl-Beitz, FEM, Gate Review trong 8 tuần

assertions.name: three_modes_routed
assertions.check: routes to Targeted Drills, Interleaving Schedule and Focus Session by input phrase

assertions.name: drill_stages_have_scoring
assertions.check: each drill stage has a measurable pass target, not just a duration

assertions.name: rule1_spans_days
assertions.check: rule 1 explicitly counts Mon PM → Wed AM as consecutive, so adjacency is checked across day boundaries

assertions.name: mixed_session_exception_stated
assertions.check: states that a mixed session may sit next to one of its own topics — without this, any schedule with A+B sessions is ambiguous
assertions.regex: mixed session .{0,40}may sit next to one of its own topics

assertions.name: walk_adjacent_pairs_before_output
assertions.check: before output, the schedule is walked pair by pair against rule 1
assertions.regex: check rule 1 on every adjacent pair

assertions.name: rule3_week1_exception_explicit
assertions.check: the only allowed rule-3 break (Week 1 Mon PM introduces B) is named, not silent
assertions.regex: Week 1 Mon PM introduces Topic B

assertions.name: fourth_week_integration
assertions.check: every 4th week has no new material

assertions.name: requirements_drill_uses_odi
assertions.check: requirements drill uses the ODI outcome statement formula

assertions.name: focus_block_sums_to_90
assertions.check: the focus session is fully timed from 0:00 to 1:30

assertions.name: ends_with_core_next_action
assertions.check: every plan ends with a Core next action the learner executes

assertions.name: analyst_trap_check
assertions.check: every plan ends with an analyst-trap check that forces at least one physical drill
